keySentence: The frog became a prince because of kindness.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They lived happily. Kindness was the magic. The frog was now a prince. The frog became a prince because of kindness.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The prince and princess became the best of friends. The whole kingdom celebrated the magical transformation. The frog became a prince because of kindness and love. The princess learned that keeping promises is very important. She also learned that kindness can create real magic. They all lived happily ever after in the castle.
